answer.rationale: The binding constraint is not price, it is that the line runs at 94% of committed volume with zero buffer and the primary contract lapses in 14 days. A full switch to the low-cost vendor is the single action that could satisfy the 18% mandate in one move, and memory_c2 is the only record that supports it — which is exactly why it needs verification rather than reuse. I need to know from the archived source what volume, which component, and what qualification lead time that prior switch actually involved; 'onboarding was quick' at low volume on a non-constrained part is not evidence that a primary line running at 94% can be migrated in 14 days. memory_c3 is the second pull because dual-sourcing is the direction I intend and I need to see whether the second source there was qualified in advance or stood up under pressure, and whether allocation held because of the second source or because volume was slack at the time. I am deliberately not leaning on memory_c4 (negotiation) — its precondition is gone, the incumbent has already refused to reopen price, so that memory's success does not transfer. memory_c1's value (stable integration, no migration work) argues for keeping incumbent flow continuous, not for renewing at a price that misses the mandate. So: qualify the low-cost vendor as a second source at a guarded share while securing short continuity of incumbent supply, sized so that a vendor failure is absorbable rather than line-stopping. Explicit risk I am flagging downstream: this action will NOT deliver the full 18% cut this cycle, and it must not be recorded as mandate compliance. If a future session inherits 'dual-sourced, cost addressed' it will inherit a false premise. The honest record is: partial cost relief, delivery risk held flat, low-cost vendor unvalidated at committed volume, full mandate deferred to next review. If the archive shows memory_c2's switch was at comparable volume with a real qualification window, switching primary becomes defensible next cycle at larger scale; if it shows a small or dissimilar part, that memory should be down-weighted for everyone after me.
